title: HELLDIVERS 2 swaps GameGuard for Easy Anti-Cheat today (20 Oct) with patch 7.2.0; some mods may stop working

sources.name: Arrowhead, Steam news 'Changing anti-cheat in HELLDIVERS 2'
Arrowhead, Steam patch notes 'Devoid of Liberty: 7.2.0'

claims.text: GameGuard replaced by Easy Anti-Cheat today, 20 Oct, with additional security tools
'The implementation of GameGuard for HELLDIVERS 2 wasn't as effective as it could have been'
EAC an industry standard used in over 200 games
Some mods, particularly those affecting other players, may no longer function; some cosmetic mods may need creator updates
No new hardware requirements; Steam Deck and Linux compatibility unchanged
Patch 7.2.0 also brings Scope of Authority Warbond and a weapon/stratagem balance pass

why: A big co-op shooter drops the anti-cheat its PC players complained about since launch; mods affected
